data.name: Noble Scion
data.description: You are a member of a proud noble family, whether or not you remain in good standing with your family. +2 on Knowledge (nobility) plus gain a nobility-related boon. You are a member of a proud noble family, whether or not you remain in good standing with your family. You gain a +2 bonus on all Knowledge (nobility) checks, and Knowledge (nobility) is always considered a class skill for you. You also gain a benefit appropriate to your noble family.
